purpose: Fail-closed local boundary for current measured SLO, strict error-budget algebra, independent vendor-exit observation, revoked-primary credential proof, bounded alternate-provider service probes and compensating primary restore.

gaps.requirement: Bind one current 900-1800 second telemetry window to exact source, environment and independent telemetry family; reject stale, future, coerced or algebraically inconsistent metrics.
Recompute availability and error-budget consumption from exact integer counters; reported metrics cannot self-authorize SLO credit.
Require an alternate provider independent across provider, vendor, account, failure domain, control plane and credential before a vendor-exit drill can begin.
Require zero primary traffic, revoked primary credential, purged cache and independently observed alternate activation within 120 seconds.
Prove the old primary credential is rejected with 401/403 by an independent observer before vendor-exit success credit.
Execute at least ten unique alternate-provider probes with exact provider identity, request/observation chronology, payload binding, availability, latency and freshness floors.
Every post-mutation path must attempt primary restore up to three times and verify a healthy final baseline; otherwise return RECOVERY_REQUIRED.
SLO, provider-independence and dual-control failures must execute zero vendor mutations.
Record the bounded lifecycle in an append-only hash-chained journal without raw credentials, provider secrets or customer identifiers.

Execute one complete current disposable-staging SLO and vendor-exit/recovery run on exact A77R1-A80R1 frozen bytes with real telemetry, distinct provider failure domains, credential rejection, alternate probes and confirmed primary restoration.
